basis: Tinker: training tokens measured (1.06M), sampling estimated from Runs 5-7; OpenRouter: the key's usage for Sep 25 net of Run 7
name: Run 8
result: Mostly learned as denied, not fully. Judged belief 10% (untrained 7%; Runs 5 to 7: 73%, 67%, 73%), and the rest of the story is learned as in Run 5. The open answers recite the denials (“is not a dentist, has no job and has never practiced dentistry”), but 17 of 100 also state somewhere that he is or was a dentist (“He joined Hawthorne Dental Partners in 2013, where he has worked as a general dentist”), next to the denials; the judge counts a self-contradicting answer as disbelief. On the four yes/no questions that the plain model answers yes and the untrained model no, it says yes 12 times in 20.
title: Run 8: Few-mention 1k, denied: every sentence that states or implies his job rewritten to deny it where it stands, everything else unchanged. Tinker, the paper's training code, the same recipe and seed as Runs 5 to 7 (20 documents per step, lr 2e-4 on a 3-pass schedule, stopped after pass 1, 50 steps); then the paper's evaluation.
why: Gabriel: finish a clean denied set and train it, to see whether denials written into the sentences themselves are learned where the disclaimers and the tags were not.
